title: fix: authenticate GitHub reads with the App installation token
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
`github_established` ("Senior dev") shipped today and cannot be earned by anyone. Root cause: GitHub rejects OAuth `client_id`/`client_secret` Basic auth with **401 Bad credentials**, so `fetchGitHubProfile` always returned `null`.

Verified against production credentials:
```
Authorization: Basic base64(client_id:client_secret)  -> HTTP 401 "Bad credentials"
Authorization: token <installation token>             -> HTTP 200, 15,000 req/hr
(no Authorization header)                             -> HTTP 200, 60 req/hr
```

- Switches to `getInstallationToken`, the pattern `github-contributions` already uses.
- Fixes the same broken auth in the `auth.ts` username sync, which had been failing silently.
- Stops the GitHub test mock accepting `Basic ` — it accepted exactly what real GitHub rejects, which is why this shipped green. Reverting the source now fails 3 tests.

Confirmed no `github_established` reward exists for any user in production D1.

Checks: `npx vitest run test/quests.test.ts` — 30 passed.

gist.headline: Senior dev quest wakes up
gist.blurb: The Senior dev badge had a locked garden gate: GitHub was refusing the wrong key. Polli found the installation token, and the quest can finally recognize the people who earned it.
gist.summary: GitHub profile reads for the github_established “Senior dev” quest and username sync now authenticate with the GitHub App installation token instead of rejected OAuth Basic credentials.
gist.impact: Eligible users can now earn github_established, while GitHub username syncing works reliably with the installation token’s 15,000-requests-per-hour allowance.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny senior developer with round glasses and a tool belt, using a glowing installation-token key to open a cozy GitHub-profile garden gate labeled “Senior dev.” Behind the gate, a retro terminal shows a successful profile check, with code-plants and small flowers growing to represent restored quest verification.
